# LiveSimulators Mechanical Engineering Lab (ME-400)
> Part of the LiveSimulators interactive engineering simulation platform at https://livesimulators.com
> Dedicated URL: https://livesimulators.com/department/mechanical
> Real-time client-side Float64 ODE numerical solvers adhering strictly to published API, ISO, ASME, and AGMA engineering standards.

## Overview
LiveSimulators Mechanical is a web-based suite of 11 interactive machinery digital twin simulators and 8 forensic failure analysis studios for mechanical, rotating equipment, reliability, and plant process engineers. All solvers execute deterministically in the user's browser at 60 FPS with zero server round-trip latency, supporting dual SI Metric and US Customary engineering unit systems.

---

## 1. Centrifugal Pump Cavitation & NPSH Margin Simulator
- **Route**: `https://livesimulators.com/department/mechanical#pump`
- **Governing Standards**: API 610 12th Edition (§6.1.8, §6.1.11), ANSI/HI 9.6.1-2017 (Rotodynamic Pumps Guideline for NPSH Margin), ISO 5199 Class II.
- **Physics Core**: Solves Darcy-Weisbach friction head loss (Swamee-Jain equation), suction piping bulk velocity, suction flange pressure, Net Positive Suction Head Available (NPSHa), vendor 3% head-drop NPSHr interpolation, NPSH margin ratio (NPSHa/NPSHr), Suction Specific Speed ($N_{ss} = \frac{N \sqrt{Q}}{\text{NPSHr}^{0.75}}$), and Thoma cavitation parameter $\sigma_c$.
- **Failure Modes Guarded**: Impeller eye cavitation pitting, high suction energy vane shock, suction recirculation surge.
- **Recommended for**: Sizing refinery process pumps, boiler feed pumps, chemical transfer pumps, and verifying NPSH margins against vapor pressure spikes.

## 2. Centrifugal Compressor Surge & Polytropic Performance Simulator
- **Route**: `https://livesimulators.com/department/mechanical#compressor`
- **Governing Standards**: API 617 8th Edition (Axial and Centrifugal Compressors for Petroleum, Chemical and Gas Industry Services), ASME PTC 10 (Performance Test Codes on Compressors and Exhausters).
- **Physics Core**: Solves Schultz polytropic head ($H_p$), gas compressibility $Z_{\text{avg}}$, real-gas isentropic exponent $k$, discharge temperature ($T_2$), pressure ratio ($r_c = P_2 / P_1$), shaft power (kW), dynamic Surge Limit Line (SLL), and Surge Control Line (SCL) safety margin ($\ge 10\%$).
- **Failure Modes Guarded**: Violent reverse gas flow surges, dynamic blade stall, catastrophic axial thrust bearing overload, high-frequency pressure oscillations (> 5 Hz).
- **Recommended for**: Tuning anti-surge control valves (ASV), compressor performance testing, and multi-gas compression envelopes (Methane, Air, H2 Recycle Gas, CO2, Propane).

## 3. Reciprocating Gas Compressor & Pulsation Simulator
- **Route**: `https://livesimulators.com/department/mechanical#recip`
- **Governing Standards**: API 618 5th Edition (Reciprocating Compressors for Petroleum, Chemical and Gas Industry Services), ISO 13631.
- **Physics Core**: Time-stepping crank-angle ($\theta = 0^\circ \text{ to } 360^\circ$) kinematics, head-end/crank-end polytropic PV indicator cards, crosshead combined rod load reversals ($F_{\text{rod}} = A_p(P_{\text{he}} - P_{\text{ce}})$), acoustic pipe resonance frequency ($f_n = (2n-1)c / (4L)$), and pulsation dampener bottle volume sizing.
- **Failure Modes Guarded**: Piston rod buckling, crosshead pin lubrication starvation due to insufficient load reversal (< 15° crank angle), cylinder valve flutter and fatigue failure.

## 4. Multi-Stage Industrial Steam Turbine Simulator
- **Route**: `https://livesimulators.com/department/mechanical#turbine`
- **Governing Standards**: API 612 8th Edition / API 611, ASME PTC 6 (Steam Turbines).
- **Physics Core**: Formulation based on IAPWS-IF97 steam tables. Computes inlet superheat enthalpy ($h_1$), Mollier expansion path, isentropic efficiency ($\eta_{\text{isen}}$), exhaust steam quality ($x$), exhaust moisture percentage ($1 - x$), Willans line steam consumption rate (t/h), and actual enthalpy drop ($\Delta h$).
- **Failure Modes Guarded**: Exhaust blade water droplet erosion (Wilson line crossing, wetness > 12%), nozzle plate thermal shock, overspeed trip boundary.

## 5. Industrial Gearbox & Mesh Dynamics Simulator
- **Route**: `https://livesimulators.com/department/mechanical#gearbox`
- **Governing Standards**: AGMA 2001-D04 / AGMA 6011-J14, ISO 6336 (Calculation of load capacity of spur and helical gears).
- **Physics Core**: Gear mesh frequency ($f_{\text{gmf}} = N_p \times Z_p$), hunting tooth frequency ($f_{\text{HT}}$), Hertzian contact stress ($\sigma_H$), Lewis bending stress ($\sigma_F$), AGMA contact safety factor ($S_H \ge 1.25$), AGMA bending safety factor ($S_F \ge 1.40$), and Dowson-Higginson elastohydrodynamic (EHL) oil film thickness ($\Lambda = h_{\text{min}} / \sigma_{\text{rms}}$).
- **Failure Modes Guarded**: Flank macropitting, micro-spalling, scuffing/adhesive wear, tooth root bending fatigue fracture.

## 6. Rolling Element Bearing Defect & Enveloping Simulator
- **Route**: `https://livesimulators.com/department/mechanical#bearing`
- **Governing Standards**: ISO 281:2007 (Rolling bearings dynamic load ratings), ISO 10816-3 (Vibration severity zones A/B/C/D), ISO 15243 (Bearing damage classification).
- **Physics Core**: Kinematic defect pass frequencies: Ball Pass Frequency Outer Race (BPFO), Ball Pass Frequency Inner Race (BPFI), Ball Spin Frequency (BSF), Fundamental Train Frequency (FTF). Statistical vibration metrics: Crest Factor, Kurtosis, High-Frequency Enveloping (gE / HFE energy), and ISO 281 modified rating life ($L_{10mh}$).
- **Failure Modes Guarded**: Incipient subsurface fatigue flaking, race spalling, cage fracture, boundary lubrication starvation.

## 7. Hydrodynamic Journal Bearing & Oil Whirl/Whip Simulator
- **Route**: `https://livesimulators.com/department/mechanical#journal`
- **Governing Standards**: API 684 2nd Ed (Tutorial on Rotordynamics), DIN 31652, API 670.
- **Physics Core**: 2D steady-state Reynolds hydrodynamic lubrication PDE, Sommerfeld lubrication number ($S = \left(\frac{r}{c}\right)^2 \frac{\mu N}{P}$), hydrodynamic pressure wedge formation, minimum fluid film thickness ($h_{\text{min}}$), cross-coupled stiffness coefficients ($K_{xy}, K_{yx}$), and sub-synchronous oil whirl onset ($0.43X - 0.48X$).
- **Failure Modes Guarded**: Half-frequency oil whirl, oil whip resonance lock, Babbitt metal fatigue wipe, boundary metal-to-metal rubbing.

## 8. Rotor Dynamics & Resonant Balancing Simulator
- **Route**: `https://livesimulators.com/department/mechanical#rotor`
- **Governing Standards**: ISO 1940-1 Grade G2.5 / G1.0, API 684, ISO 10816-3.
- **Physics Core**: Jeffcott rotor dynamics model, centrifugal dynamic unbalance force ($F_c = m \cdot r \cdot \omega^2$), permissible residual unbalance ($U_{\text{per}} = \frac{1000 \cdot G \cdot M}{\omega}$), speed ratio ($\lambda = \omega / \omega_n$), damped magnification factor ($Q$), and single/two-plane influence coefficient balancing vector calculus.
- **Failure Modes Guarded**: Synchronous 1X resonant shaft deflection, destructive critical speed transition, unbalance-induced bearing fatigue.

## 9. Process Piping Thermal Flexibility & Stress Simulator
- **Route**: `https://livesimulators.com/department/mechanical#pipe`
- **Governing Standards**: ASME B31.3:2022 (Process Piping Code, §319), ASME B36.10M, API 610 Annex F nozzle load criteria.
- **Physics Core**: Thermal linear expansion ($\Delta L = \alpha \cdot L \cdot \Delta T$), guided cantilever flexibility analysis, displacement stress range ($S_E = \sqrt{S_b^2 + 4 S_t^2}$), allowable displacement stress range ($S_A = f [1.25(S_c + S_h) - S_L]$), and 3D anchor reaction forces.
- **Failure Modes Guarded**: Flange leakage, pipe buckling, thermal cyclic fatigue cracking, pump/turbine nozzle overload.

## 10. API Mechanical Seal Flush Plan Thermodynamics Simulator
- **Route**: `https://livesimulators.com/department/mechanical#seal`
- **Governing Standards**: API Standard 682 4th Edition / ISO 21049 (Pumps - Shaft sealing systems for centrifugal and rotary pumps).
- **Physics Core**: Seal face frictional heat generation ($Q_{\text{gen}} = 2\pi \cdot f \cdot P_{\text{face}} \cdot r_m^2 \cdot \omega$), flush fluid enthalpy removal, seal chamber vapor pressure margin ($\Delta T_{\text{vapor}} \ge 11^\circ\text{C}$), and dual pressurized barrier plans (Plan 11, 21, 23, 31, 32, 52, 53A, 53B, 54).
- **Failure Modes Guarded**: Seal face vaporization / flashing, dry-running carbon blistering, dangerous VOC / toxic chemical containment loss.

## 11. Laser Shaft Alignment & Thermal Growth Simulator
- **Route**: `https://livesimulators.com/department/mechanical#alignment`
- **Governing Standards**: ANSI/ASA S2.75 / API 686 Chapter 7 (Machinery Installation and Installation Design - Piping and Alignment).
- **Physics Core**: Reverse indicator dial matrix, laser triangulation optics, machine thermal foot growth calculation ($\Delta H = \alpha \cdot H \cdot \Delta T$), front/rear foot shim move vectors, and coupling gap angularity tolerances.
- **Failure Modes Guarded**: 2X misalignment vibration harmonics, high coupling flex fatigue, premature seal and bearing failure.

---

## 8 Integrated Failure Analysis & Diagnostic Engineering Studios
In addition to individual machinery twins, LiveSimulators Mechanical integrates 8 cross-asset engineering studios:
1. **Diagnostic Troubleshooter Wizard**: Interactive multi-symptom Bayesian failure tree resolving ISO vibration spectra into root causes.
2. **Industrial Incident Archive**: 11 forensic case studies of historic catastrophic equipment failures with causal factors and remediation.
3. **Weibull Reliability Studio**: 2-parameter Weibull life distribution ($\beta, \eta$), MTTF, and $B_{10}$ mechanical reliability modeling.
4. **Machinery Train Cascade Studio**: Multi-machine coupled driveline trip propagation simulator (Motor + Gearbox + Compressor + Lube Skid).
5. **Spectral FFT Laboratory**: Interactive frequency spectrum generator simulating 1X, 2X, harmonics, sidebands, and noise floors.
6. **Transient Run-Up Dynamics Studio**: Bode plots and Polar Nyquist plots during acceleration through critical speeds.
7. **Fleet Health Severity Matrix**: Enterprise multi-asset condition monitoring overview color-coded to ISO 10816 alarm thresholds.
8. **Forensic RCA Studio**: Ishikawa Fishbone and 5-Why root cause analysis studio with exportable engineering reports.
